description: Header file defining interfaces for creating and managing various types of repeating background tasks, including fixed-rate, delayed, and backoff strategies. It provides function prototypes, callback types, and constants for task control and customization.

methods.name: createRepeatingTask
methods.description: Creates a looped task that executes a specified callback with a delay between iterations, until canceled.

methods.name: createFixedRateRepeatingTask
methods.description: Creates a task that runs at a fixed interval, starting immediately with specified delay between executions.

methods.name: createBackOffRepeatingTask
methods.description: Creates a backoff task that increases delay after each iteration until a maximum delay is reached; can invoke a success callback upon completion.

methods.name: cancelRepeatingTask
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled task, returning the associated argument for cleanup.

methods.name: shortCircuitRepeatingTask
methods.description: Forces a repeating task to stop waiting and proceed immediately.

methods.name: changeRepeatingTask
methods.description: Updates the delay configuration for an existing repeating task, optionally applying immediately.
